notes.title: Meet our newest puzzle game!
notes.content:
Imagine yourself being in the greatest musea by solving the Jigsaw Puzzles of master artists like Monet, Haring, Kadinsky, Hokusai, Rousseau and Rembrandt. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39580520/842ac8ef5a17d54734374ddd772610c673a7870f.jpg

All major art style are represented in more dan 100 high quality puzzles. Enjoy the modern UI and 4 difficulty levels (30/120/300/600 pieces).


https://youtu.be/x4yzrXytm5k

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197960/House_of_Jigsaw_Masters_of_Art/

notes.title: Soon available on Steam: Puzzle Pieces 4: Farewell Dear Winter
notes.content:
We are more thant to share this news with our Steam family, a new game full of puzzles is available soon. Puzzle Pieces 4: Farewell Dear Winter will be released on February 23.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqNnaIE1Dos
Puzzle Pieces 4: Farewell Dear Winter
With this Jigsaw gameplay and dazzling collection of puzzles, the beauty never stops. The pictures are a mix of beautiful winter and spring scenes. There are a lot of options to choose, from puzzle shape and number of pieces. You will love to use your own images and create puzzles from them.

Please visit the Steampage and add this awesome puzzlegame to your wishlist  now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2269720/
